[7] (ran5_cr_chunks 38.533, sim=0.4485)
Reason for change: In TC 16.4.1.1 and 16.4.1.2, for config 3: BW 20MHz with 51RBs; SRS config is set to be “SRSconf.1”. It means c-SRS=25, b-SRS=0. According to 38.211 Table 6.4.1.4.3-1, SRS has 104RB. It means SRS RBs exceeds BW RBs. SRS config should be update and make sure SRS is within BW. In TC 16.4.3.1 and 16.4.3.2, for config 3: BW 20MHz with 51RBs; c-SRS=24, b-SRS=0. According to 38.211 Table 6.4.1.4.3-1, SRS has 96RB. It means SRS RBs exceeds BW RBs. SRS config should be update and make sure SRS is within BW. In TC 16.5.3.1.1 and 16.5.3.1.2, there are no test config 5&6, but there are TRS configurations for test config 5&6. They are typor error. Summary of change: Core spec alignment with 38.133: In TC 16.4.1.1, introduce a new table to add SRS configuration. And TC 16.4.1.2 reuse
